On MuSiQue-Ans, the C-only model scores **3.4 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 on the validation set**, and **3.7 answer F1 and 0.0 support F1 on the test set**.

*The document has no printed page numbers, so the pages below are counted from the start of the text.*

**What the C-only model is (p. 10):** It sees only the context, not the question. It is an End2End Longformer-Large model given an empty question.

**Scores:**
- **Validation set:** 3.4 answer (An) and 0.0 support (Sp), from Table 4 (p. 11). Table 6 (p. 11) and the 20-paragraph positive-distractor row of Table 7 (p. 12) report the same numbers.
- **Test set:** 3.7 An and 0.0 Sp, from Table 5 (p. 11). Page 10 says Table 5 reports test-set numbers and everything else uses the validation set.
- **MuSiQue-Full, for comparison:** 1.6 An+Sf and 1.1 Sp+Sf, from Table 5 (p. 11).

**How this compares to other datasets (pp. 11–12):** On HotpotQA and 2WikiMultihopQA, the C-only model identifies supporting paragraphs surprisingly well (67.6 and 92.0 support F1) but "fails on MuSiQue-Ans" (p. 11). The authors credit the positive-distractor design. Had they drawn distractors from full Wikipedia, C-only support F1 on MuSiQue-Ans would have been 66.4 (p. 12, Table 7).
